product: 硅胶折叠水杯（带挂扣），资料见 spec.txt

traps.rule: Antibacterial / antimicrobial / anti-mold / mildew claims make a product a 'pesticide' under EPA FIFRA in Amazon US policy; needs EPA registration or removal. Must NOT appear in English listing; should be flagged.
Unqualified 'eco-friendly'/'non-toxic' environmental claims need substantiation (FTC Green Guides 16 CFR 260.4, 260.10); no test report provided. Must NOT appear; should be flagged.

traps.supplier_claim: （资料写明：无任何检测报告或认证）
traps.rule: Must NOT claim FDA approved/compliant, LFGB, BPA-free, or any certification.
Must NOT say microwave safe; ideally warns not microwave safe.
Must NOT claim leak-proof / spill-proof; ideally warns it leaks when tipped.

traps.supplier_claim: 杯盖 PP 只耐 100℃，硅胶杯身耐 230℃
traps.rule: Must NOT imply the whole cup incl. lid handles 230℃/446°F; should state lid limit 100℃/212°F.
'Best seller'/'#1'/'hot item' subjective or unverifiable claims are not allowed in Amazon titles.
